itinerary.title: Shimla Ridge & Mall Road
itinerary.description: Arrival in Shimla, evening stroll on The Ridge and Mall Road, Christ Church view.

itinerary.title: Kufri Excursion
itinerary.description: Day trip to Kufri for pony rides, Himalayan Nature Park and valley views.

itinerary.title: Chail Getaway
itinerary.description: Drive to Chail, visit the Chail Palace grounds and the world's highest cricket ground.

itinerary.title: Naldehra & Mashobra
itinerary.description: Naldehra golf course meadows and Mashobra orchard drive.

itinerary.title: Kasauli Day Trip
itinerary.description: Colonial-era Kasauli town, Sunset Point and Christ Church.

itinerary.title: Sarahan - Bhimakali Temple
itinerary.description: Drive to Sarahan, visit the Bhimakali Temple complex and apple orchards.

itinerary.title: Kalpa Intro
itinerary.description: Onward to Kalpa for first views of the Kinner Kailash range.

itinerary.title: Sangla Valley
itinerary.description: Drive into the Sangla Valley via the Baspa river gorge.
